subtitles.description: List of subtitle lines with timing and translations.

index.description: The sequential index of the subtitle line.

timingStart.description: The start timing of the subtitle in the format 'HH:MM:SS,MS'.

timingEnd.description: The end timing of the subtitle in the format 'HH:MM:SS,MS'.

line.description: The original subtitle line in Japanese.

translation.description: The complete translation of the line in Ukrainian.

kanjies.description: List of kanji that used in the subtitle, joined by coma

grammars.description: List of grammars that used in the subtitle, joined by coma

individualTranslations.description: Translations of each kanji or phrase used in the line.

textHiragana.description: The word or phrase in Hiragana

meaning.description: Meaning of the word or phrase

jlpt.description: JLPT score from N1 to N5
